points.text: Missing comparisons with recent strong baselines such as NSH and NeurCADRecon.
Figure 1 lacks ground-truth shapes, so zero-level surface improvement is not convincing.
Input point clouds are not visualized in figures.
No data-centric ablations on density, noise, missing regions or irregular sampling.
Main baseline SIREN (2020) is outdated.
Experiments mostly lack significant noise; limited robustness analysis on noisy or irregular point clouds.
Theory relies on strong assumptions (bounded gradients, smoothness) of unclear practical validity.
No evaluation on real-world scans such as ScanNet.
Theory analyzes standard Eikonal, not ViscoReg with decaying viscosity; decay lacks theoretical support.
Runtime and memory overhead of Laplacian computation not reported.
Evaluation limited to SIREN; generalization to ReLU MLPs or hash encodings unclear.
Complex epsilon decay schedule needs per-shape tuning, increasing usage complexity.
Missing visual comparison with ViscoGrids.
Missing comparison with HotSpot.
Limited novelty over ViscoGrids, which uses the same regularized Eikonal idea.
Theorem 1 gives no specific insight into the optimizer; holds for any gradient-bounded function.
No experiments showing the theorem's practical impact on computations.
Distinction from DiGS overstated; no ablation against annealed Laplacian with same schedule.
Delta over VisCo Grids is only decay and network.
Theory is loose extension of PINN theory; 'first estimate' claim unsupported, HotSpot not discussed.
Bound covers plain Eikonal loss, not the proposed viscous loss.
Incorrect citations: PINN attribution to review [24], [47]/[48] confusion.
Missing citation and comparison with Neural-Singular-Hessian.
Gains are incremental; lower IoU than StEik on ShapeNet.
SDF sign convention not stated.
Typos: 'dc' caption, VisCo Grids naming.
Theory concerns plain Eikonal loss and does not apply to ViscoReg.
Theoretical bound is never evaluated.
Table 3 caption and text overstate results; IoU lower than StEik.
Table presentation: undefined delta columns, 'wo n', labels, unlabeled single-shape ablation.
Central qualitative claims rely on curated figures with captions only.
No timing to support 'no significant computational cost' claim.
No error bars or variance in tables.
Typos and citation slips.
Stability analysis is local linearization, ignoring nonlinear regime near medial axis.
SDF sign convention never stated.
Missing connections to heat method, level sets and PINN failure-mode work.
Hyperparameter burden of annealing schedule understated; sensitivity noticeable.
Deterministic noise-free sampling assumption conflicts with noisy SRB and random sampling.
No broader-impact discussion.
Schedules selected on test shapes; baselines not tuned equally; comparison fails across sweep.
Theorem covers plain Eikonal loss; method has no bound.
Bound is never evaluated.
Assumption 1 incompatible with an SDF-like network with small boundary loss.
Claims in Table 3 caption, text and abstract overstated.
Novelty against DiGS is only cross term and schedule.
Computational cost claim has no measurement.
Stability analysis errors: Fourier sign, operator, kappa assumed positive, unregularized flow also stable.
Single runs, no variance, small gains.
Numerical inconsistencies between Table 1 and Table 4.
Citation errors ([24] review, [47] vs [48]).
Delta columns undefined and p unstated in Table 1.
Hyperparameters tuned per shape on evaluated shapes while baselines reported once.
Assumption 1 excludes the regime described; constant must be huge.
Bound constants uncontrolled and bound never evaluated numerically.
Bound holds for plain Eikonal loss, not ViscoReg.
Lemma 2 constant dependence inverted and applied outside its hypotheses.
Stability claim heuristic with wrong algebra and assumed sign; plain Eikonal also stable.
Claims stronger than Tables 1-3 support (IoU, median Chamfer, lordquas).
No time or memory evidence for computational cost claim.
Minor table inconsistencies, undefined columns, unstated p, ambiguous caption.

P.summary: Missing comparison with recent baselines; SIREN baseline outdated.
No robustness experiments on noise, density, missing regions, irregular sampling.
Theory rests on strong assumptions of unclear practical validity.
Theory analyzes plain Eikonal, not ViscoReg with decay.
Epsilon decay schedule needs per-shape tuning.
No experiments on theorem's practical impact.

Q.summary: Novelty over DiGS thin; missing annealed-Laplacian ablation.
Novelty over VisCo Grids is only decay and network.
'First estimate' claim unsupported; HotSpot theory not discussed.
Theory covers plain Eikonal loss, not ViscoReg.
Undefined table columns and labels; p unstated.
Qualitative claims rely on curated figures.
Stability analysis local, flawed or heuristic.
Hyperparameter burden of annealing schedule understated.
Hyperparameters selected on test shapes; unequal baseline tuning.
Deterministic sampling assumption conflicts with noisy data.
